coverage.method: Sitemap/navigation discovery, page-family HTML/CSS inspection, selected browser screenshots and runtime probes where permitted.
coverage.viewports: 1440px desktop and 390px mobile; not every source page was rendered.
coverage.limits: Public page families sampled, not every article, locale, private app or interaction state. Source-only theme/motion declarations are not runtime verification.

color.palette_type: nature-vocabulary token system — full 'green' + 'ink' + 'paper' scales plus earth-named semantics (soil/sky/amber/ember); THREE themed surfaces: app (paper white + electric lime), landing (warm cream + forest green via data-theme=landing), dark

app_theme_default.accent: #6fd305 (green-500, electric lime) — hover #5cb300, press #3a6e0e, soft #f4fce4, ring #6fd30573
app_theme_default.primary: #1c2024 (ink-900 — primary actions are ink, accent is the brand green)
app_theme_default.text: fg-1 #1c2024 / fg-2 #656c75 / fg-3 #828a93 / muted #aeb5be (cool blue-gray 'ink' scale)

landing_theme.note: Landing tokens warm the paper to #f7f6f1 and ink to #0b1a14, with forest accent #086030. Theme primary aliases do not establish every button fill: sampled main actions are ink.

dark_theme.note: primary flips to green-600 in dark (green becomes the action color)

earth_semantics.note: semantic tokens are named after nature (soil/sky/amber/ember), not status words — the brand metaphor lives in the token layer itself

color.docs_site: Fumadocs (Next.js) re-skinned via --ms-* bridge tokens: same green/ink scales mapped onto fd-* vars; dark docs are green-tinted near-blacks (#0d0f0c bg, #12160f card, #14180f code bg, #9aa39a olive-gray muted text)
color.contrast_strategy: cool ink-on-paper for the app (near-black #1c2024 on #fbfbfc), warm moss-on-cream for the landing; lime accent reserved for brand moments/CTAs/focus rings; alpha borders on every surface

typography.fonts: Cabinet Grotesk variable for landing display, Geist/Inter for UI, Geist Mono code. Docs use DM Sans with Hanken Grotesk fallback and JetBrains Mono.
typography.marketing: Home h1 84/85.68, weight 500, tracking -2.94px at 1440px. Pricing h1 64/66.56, weight 500, tracking -2.048px; plan h2 32/35.2, tracking -0.64px.
typography.body: Application default 15/21.75, weight 500; main CTA 15px/600. Source fs ramp 12,13,14,15,16,18,20,24,30,36,48,64 does not include every landing override.

spacing.content_density: app console compact (13–15px UI sizes); landing comfortable
spacing.section_rhythm: landing sections revealed on scroll via use-in-view; consistent token-stepped gaps

layout.frame: Application shell has its own scrolling region; body height alone is not page height. Marketing is framed by vertical rules on warm cream.
layout.hero: Centered 84px Cabinet Grotesk statement, announcement pill, ink/outlined actions and a wide colorful text-pattern canvas.
layout.pricing: Centered 64px heading over three ruled plan columns with ink CTA and green checks; cooler ink/paper tokens than the warm hero.
layout.mobile: 390px: logo, locale/social/login remain in the header; centered wrapped title, two actions then API-docs link; canvas still present.
layout.docs: Fumadocs three-column shell with DM Sans/Hanken Grotesk, green active state, copy/open controls and JetBrains Mono code.
layout.blog: Separate editorial site with Cabinet/Geist typography and category/language navigation.

shape.radius_scale: tokenized --r-xs 4 / sm 6 / md 10 / lg 14 / xl 20px — mid-round, softer than square-cornered dev tools but no pills-by-default
shape.border_usage: translucent ink-alpha hairlines at three strengths (0f/1a/29) so one token set works over any surface; shadow-inset token doubles as a 1px inner ring

elevation.shadow_style: 5-step layered soft shadows, all derived from the ink color at low alpha (xs '0 1px 0' hairline lift → xl '0 30px 60px'); landing variant recolors shadows to the moss ink; dark theme deepens to black alphas
elevation.depth_cues: bg-sunken/bg-elevated surface stepping + alpha borders first, shadows for floating UI

iconography.style: stroke icons (Base UI component library appears in bundle); favicon.svg brand mark

motion.philosophy: quick, springy micro-reveals; scroll-triggered section entries; one signature AI shimmer
motion.keyframes_observed: landing-hero-reveal (240ms fade+14px rise, staggered delays 40/120/200/280ms), environment-row-enter (rows drop in -6px + scale .99), mosoo-thinking-dot (bouncing dots) + mosoo-thinking-sweep (1.8s text shimmer: background-clip:text gradient sweeping 200% — the 'agent is thinking' indicator), pulse
motion.libraries: framer-motion/motion for React (motion + motion-variants chunks) with use-in-view scroll reveals

components.buttons: Observed main CTA: ink fill, 48px height, 10px radius, 15px/600 label; secondary outlined. Green/lime accent and focus tokens vary by landing/app scope.
components.thinking_indicator: signature component: shimmer-swept gradient text (fg-3→fg-1→fg-3 at 40/50/60% stops) + bouncing dots — the AI-working state is a first-class design token
components.console_demo: Bounded console/runtime demonstrations and code below the hero; model names and example tasks are changing content, not design tokens.
components.code_blocks: docs: Fumadocs Shiki blocks on green-tinted dark (#14180f) with fd-diff add/remove tokens
components.i18n_switcher: EN / 中 / 日 language menu, cookie + path-prefix routing

design_style.mood: Organic cream/ink/green vocabulary around a technically expressive agent-runtime product.
design_style.composition: Large rounded-grotesk headline and monochrome actions over a colorful flowing field of repeated letters; ruled sections switch to practical console, API and documentation layouts.
design_style.imagery: Unicorn Studio canvas is a rainbow text-pattern wave, not a flat forest-green backdrop. Product/API demos and code provide evidence below.
design_style.interaction: Rounded 10px ink actions, green selection/status, constrained panel borders; docs use a quieter separate typography system.

visual_effects.technology: Unicorn Studio script and one live homepage canvas confirmed. Client-rendered page must be inspected after JS; static HTML alone cannot describe its hero.
visual_effects.hero: Broad flowing rainbow band with repeated mosoo-like glyphs over a pale stippled field. Pointer/render implementation belongs to the embedded scene; exact scene parameters were not recovered.
visual_effects.motion: Source supplies short fade/rise transitions and shimmer/loader utilities; separate blog CSS has motion-fade and motion-rise.
visual_effects.responsive: Canvas persists at 390px (525×990 buffer in sample); text/CTA wrap while the graphic crops to the frame.
visual_effects.themes: Landing warm cream/forest palette, cooler application paper/lime palette and source dark tokens are separate scopes; no private console or live dark theme audited.

page_families./en: Cabinet display, cream/ink shell, rainbow glyph canvas and console/runtime sections.
page_families./en/pricing; /en/use-cases: Plan and use-case variants; three pricing columns and stronger practical UI treatment.
page_families./health: Status surface reached from the old /en/status route.
page_families./blog: Separate editorial build with Cabinet/Geist and language/category navigation.
page_families./docs/quickstart/: DM Sans documentation, green active nav and monospace code; distinct from 84px marketing display.
